subject: Sentinel Finance - service integrity post-incident summary & evidence bundle
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@sentinelfin.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com
Cc: sec-team@sentinelfin.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observed tokenization mismatches during 10/12 window — request for RCA and artifacts

Vanessa / Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick phone update earlier. As discussed, our security and compliance team needs a concise RCA plus artifact bundle to satisfy our internal audit (SOC2 evidence). Specifically we need:

- One-page executive RCA explaining what happened and the impact window (UTC).
- A timeline of control-plane events and any failovers.
- Proof that no customer data left Sentinel's VPC and logs showing request routing.
- Artifacts: timeline_and_playback.log.txt, any heapdumps or KV cache snapshots, and a signed attestation from Redwood that the issue has been mitigated.

Can you confirm an ETA for the bundle and whether we can get the signed attestation by Friday 10/16?

Appreciate it — Alicia
Alicia Ramos
Head of Risk & Compliance, Sentinel Finance
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@sentinelfin.com>, sec-team@sentinelfin.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observed tokenization mismatches during 10/12 window — request for RCA and artifacts

Alicia — thank you for the clear ask and for the call. We understand the urgency. Quick summary up front:

- Impact window: 2026-10-12T14:07:18Z to 2026-10-12T14:22:43Z (UTC).
- Short RCA (executive): an orchestrator failover caused a stale KV-cache slice to be served for a subset of warm sessions, resulting in tokenization mismatches for <0.05% of requests during the window. No data exfiltration detected.

What we are delivering and proposed ETA:
- By EOD Tue 10/13: one-page executive RCA and a technical timeline (PDF).
- By EOD Wed 10/14: artifact bundle (logs, kvcache snapshot, playback traces) + signed attestation template for your legal team.
- By Fri 10/16: completed signed attestation (if your procurement requires a counter-signature; let me know preferred signer).

Attachments sent here are an index of artifacts we are preparing; I attached timeline_and_playback.log.txt as a first file. Full evidence bundle will be posted to a secure Drive link and we will provide a short verification checklist.

Next steps (owners):
- Hannah (cc): run evidence sanity checks and produce the kvcache dump (Hannah to deliver by 10/14).
- Neha (cc): prepare the signed attestation + legal language options.
- Vanessa: coordinate delivery and confirm the Drive link and any DocuSign flow.

We will follow the SOC2 evidence format you shared on the call. Will keep this thread for the customer-facing artifacts and spin a separate internal-only thread for the deeper technical forensic notes.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Accounts Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — account lead for Sentinel Finance
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Observed tokenization mismatches during 10/12 window — customer asks and artifact list

Team — forwarding Alicia's ask. Key technical details we need consolidated in the evidence bundle:

1) Orchestrator failover timeline (controller logs + exact UTC timestamps).
2) KV-cache snapshots for affected pods and correlation to request ids.
3) Tokenization mismatch playback traces (sanitized) for 25 example requests.
4) Network ACL and VPC flow logs to confirm no outbound egress.
5) The remediation checklist showing the patch that prevented recurrence and the date deployed (already in canary 10/12 18:00Z).

Hannah — please produce the kvcache-heapdump-20261012.tar.gz (redact any PII) and the timeline_and_playback.log.txt with a short readme. Aim: 10/14 EOD.
Neha — prep the signed-attestation-template.pdf and two options of wording (attestation vs. representation).
Grace — verify that the service mesh egress logs show no remote destinations. Pull the VPC flow logs for 10/12 14:00–15:00Z and add to bundle.

Keep notes inline here — once we have bundle I will share the Drive link with Alicia. If any blocker, call me immediately.

-Vanessa
From: Michael Turner <mturner@sentinelfin.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@sentinelfin.com>, sec-team@sentinelfin.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observed tokenization mismatches during 10/12 window — request for RCA and artifacts

Thanks Vanessa — this plan works. Two quick clarifications from our side before you publish the bundle: 

1) For the sanitized playback traces, can you include request ids and a short mapping file so our engineering team can run the same assertions?
2) For the signed attestation, we need Redwood's signer to be an officer (VP+). If you cannot sign at that level, confirm expected timeline for an officer-signed letter.

If possible, include an explicit list of user impact (accounts affected by ID or hashed id) and whether any retries were served with corrected KV cache.

-Michael
Principal Engineer, Sentinel Finance
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@sentinelfin.com>, Michael Turner <mturner@sentinelfin.com>, sec-team@sentinelfin.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Sentinel Finance — post-incident package, commitments, and verification steps

Alicia / Michael / Sentinel team,

Attached and linked below is the complete post-incident package we committed to deliver:

- Executive RCA (PDF) — short cause statement and impact summary.
- Technical timeline (CSV) — controller events and timestamps.
- timeline_and_playback.log.txt — playback traces with 25 example requests (sanitized).
- kvcache-heapdump-20261012.tar.gz (stub) — redacted KV-cache snapshot.
- evidence-index.csv — manifest of included artifacts and checksums.
- signed-attestation-template.pdf — initial attestation; we can provide officer signature.

Drive link (secure): https://drive.redwood.example.com/teams/secure/Sentinel-Finance-evidence-bundle
Read-only verification checklist: https://docs.redwood.example.com/incidents/2026-10-12-sentinel-postmortem

Direct responses to your asks:
- Request IDs: playback traces include redwood-request-id and a mapping file that your engineers can use to validate.
- Officer-signed attestation: Our VP of Security (Hannah Schmitt) can sign. Neha is preparing the final DocuSign envelope and will route to your legal by 10/15 EOD.
- User impact list: We include hashed account ids (sha256) for the affected requests and a short note that retries were served with corrected cache in 98% of retry cases.
- Data exfiltration: confirmed none — VPC flow logs and egress ACLs attached.

Planned follow-up:
- 10/16 10:00 PT — 30-minute verification call (we will walk your engineers through the playback and mapping). Link will be in the calendar invite.
- 10/20 — 2-week follow-up to confirm any additional evidence or contractual language you require.

If you need the officer signature faster, we'll prioritize and aim to have the signed PDF to you within 24 hours.

Thanks again for the partnership while we worked through this — if you want a separate technical deep-dive with our runtime team, Grace and Hannah are available.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Accounts Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments (referenced): timeline_and_playback.log.txt, evidence-index.csv, kvcache-heapdump-20261012.tar.gz (stub), signed-attestation-template.pdf
